summary: The corrected catch-up evidence supports continued publication hold and minimal useful coverage. Overlapping reports are not added, four retained eligible order records supply no observed X signal, and store-wide sessions are not credited to X. Calendar reconciliation matches the historical native submissions without promoting them to publication. The broader retrospective is now distinguished from the original seven-day cohort. No unresolved correction or new posting permission follows from this review.

28 referrer rows, below the 100-row limit, sum to 1991 store sessions. No named X/Twitter/t.co row is present and no store total is credited to X.

Four retained rows satisfy supplied bounds/checkpoint flags and PAID/non-test/noncancelled/web criteria. Counts match four eligible orders; September22 status is not represented as historical September19 status.
Reported outer/moment completeness flags agree. Moment counts are 1,0,1,1. Nine boundary-inclusive observations are not promoted to nine independent visits.

Retained visit classifications and row summaries contain no X signal. All seven synthetic URL fixtures match an independent Python reference interpretation; this is not production-parser reconstruction.

Reduced order rows retain no raw IDs, actual URLs, precise timestamps or customer identity. Costs/contribution and actual X outcomes remain unknown; acquisition and parent sales cohorts remain separate.

All seven historical saved bodies/dates match the frozen queue and launch receipt. Five planned dates have elapsed; R007 and R008 remain future at review time. No new publication receipt or native pending count is invented.
Publisher remains disconnected with existing setup question pending. No setup, repeated question, X website fallback or mutation is represented as authorized or performed.
No extra draft, replay, winner or extension is selected. Three-to-four originals/week and one/day limits, local R009-R011 gates and September26 checkpoint are preserved.

No missed run is backfilled. Source-freeze elapsed time matches timestamps; prior September15 completion is outside trailing seven days at freeze. The 120-minute cap and unquantified effort limitations remain explicit.

limitations: This verifies retained-record consistency, not independent raw attribution reconstruction. Original IDs/URLs/timestamps were discarded before handoff; distinctness, exact row membership and original classification cannot be independently rederived.
Live schema validation, accepted Shopify responses, completeness flags and raw-data disposal are root-supplied. No new live request or private record inspection occurred.

URL strings in parser_checks are synthetic fixtures, not retained customer visit URLs. Fixture agreement does not certify the entire production reducer or untested parser cases.

Source verification PENDING fields reflect its freeze. Current root completion belongs in mutable EXECUTION_STATUS.json; this review does not replace or edit that record.
No current X rendering, native queue, published post, buyer outcome, positive contribution, full effort accounting or future runtime availability is independently established.
